title: Go to Layout inside Loop
description: Performance rule — Go to Layout inside a Loop forces a context switch on every iteration.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Switching layouts inside a loop re-renders the window and reloads the context each pass.
rule.remediation: Navigate once before the loop, or use a server-side / relationship approach.
